result.title: PAVE: A Harness for Geometrically Consistent Road Network Modeling with Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Transportation models, whether they simulate traffic or support planning, are only as reliable as the road networks they run on, down to the lanes and turns at each intersection. Practitioners still take such a network from GIS files and supply its junction and movement data by hand, a task that recurs with each new base year and design alternative, or they generate it from open map data. OpenStreetMap's lane tags give the correct layout for only 13 of the 44 approaches we test; open map data are often incomplete or inaccurate. Satellite and street-level imagery, in contrast, cover all 44 and show their lanes as painted. Vision-language models (VLMs) can read such imagery, but asked directly they lose geometric consistency when the same lane must be matched across a satellite crop, street-level photos taken from different poses and an ID-labelled network. We therefore present PAVE (Perceive, Anchor, Verify, Edit), a harness in which code measures what can be measured, traffic engineering knowledge enters as general rules and checks, and the model makes only the open judgements, each anchored to network IDs so that checks catch answers that contradict a measurement, a second reading or a traffic rule. Scored against human labels at signalised intersections, PAVE raises the share of exactly correct lane layouts from 49-64% with a single request to 86-91% for two VLMs, with most of the gain coming from reading one approach at a time on traced lanes. The same division of work edits a real network to a planning brief: the model names the links and nodes of each part of a facility, and code builds the edit from a design template. Of 18 edits, 16 pass every network check, against none when the model writes its own code, and 2 contain a design or coding error, against 7. An analysis shows where VLMs lose geometric consistency and which check catches each failure.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PAVE（Perceive、Anchor、Verify、Edit）流程，让代码负责可测量量、以交通工程规则作检查，VLM 只做开放判断并以路网 ID 锚定，用于从卫星与街景影像生成及编辑车道级路网，并在信号交叉口上以人工标注评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「测量与规则交代码、模型判断须与测量或二次读数对照」的分工，以及跨视角几何一致性失败的分析，可能为 LVR 中的证据核验、贡献分配与视觉信息旁路问题提供可核查线索。
